# Cellebrite’s Mission is to Protect Communities, Nations and Businesses


November 11, 2026


| Cellebrite


*Watch the video above to hear our mission in action.*


Cellebrite’s mission is clear: protect communities, nations and businesses. Our vision is to be the trusted platform for investigations and intelligence-led operations, transforming digital data across devices, sources and environments into defensible evidence, mission-ready intelligence and informed action.
